validity.recommendation: Keep as-is. Do NOT 'fix' the 83 km to 166 km, and do NOT merge P6721/P6722 as a duplicate.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real. The Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3 / MGS III) is a well-documented ~$10-11bn Aramco program; the specific EWPS-3-to-EWPS-4 corridor of the new 56-inch east-west gas trunk lines 'three' and 'four' is named explicitly by MEED (the sheet's own cited source) and independently by Blackridge Research. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct - these are the main east-west 56-inch gas transmission trunk lines (transmission, Gas); confirmed by all sources. DUPLICATE check: P6722 ('EWPS-3-EWPS-4 "4"', same 83 km) is NOT a duplicate of P6721 - lines '3' and '4' are two physically distinct parallel pipelines laid along the same corridor; keeping them as separate rows is correct. SPEC/length: this was the main thing I stress-tested. MEED and Blackridge both give the EWPS-3-to-EWPS-4 figure as 166 km, i.e. 2x GEM's 83 km, which looks alarming at first. But the source figures are the COMBINED pipe length for both parallel lines 3+4 over the corridor (corridor ~83 km x 2 lines = 166 km), so GEM correctly split 166 into 83 (line 3) + 83 (line 4). Cross-check confirms this: summing all GEM MGS-III segment rows totals ~4,080 km, matching the reported program total of ~4,000 km (MEED) / ~4,153 km (Blackridge); the doubled interpretation (166 km per line) would inflate the program to ~5,900 km, far above the reported total. So 83 km per line is right. DIAMETER 56 in: confirmed by MEED, Blackridge, and Pipeline Journal (L&T's completed 56-inch section). OWNER Aramco 100%: confirmed (Aramco owns and operates MGS-3). CAVEAT for reviewer: a sibling row, P6727/P6728 (EWPS-8-EWPS-10, GEM 190+190=380 km) appears UNDER-stated vs the sources' 480 km for that corridor (would be ~240 each) - flag for that row's audit, not this one. Endpoints EWPS-3/EWPS-4 are internal Aramco station designations along the Eastern-Province-to-west corridor; no public coordinates found, so province left blank rather than guessed.

Province-level start/end left blank - EWPS-3/EWPS-4 are internal station codes with no public coordinates, and I will not fabricate a province.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' is current and correct. Timeline of dated evidence: EPC contracts awarded / signing ceremony mid-2024, construction commenced Q2 2024; Blackridge notes on-site activities commenced as of Jan 2025; Pipeline Journal (Sept 10, 2025) reports L&T COMPLETED a 120 km 56-inch section of the MGS-3 EW system with a further 241 km section mobilized for construction - i.e. the program is actively mid-build, well short of the Q4 2028 target completion. Newest independent evidence: 2025-09. No evidence this specific EWPS-3-EWPS-4 sub-segment is yet mechanically complete/operating, so 'construction' stands (not yet 'operating'). StartYear1=2028 is consistent with the Q4-2028 completion target (MEED, Blackridge). Not stale - well within thresholds and with 2025 progress news.

summary: P6721 confirmed real, correctly classified (56-inch gas transmission trunk), not a duplicate of parallel line P6722, all specs corroborated by 2 independent sources; status construction confirmed (L&T section done Sept 2025, target 2028).
